item.tib: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu bskor las mdel kha sbyin sreg gi 'phyong
item.coloph: ces pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ drag po las kyi mdel kha/ gsang sngags gsang ba'i tan tra/ mtha' bsdu las kyi sbyin sreg 'di yang dpal snya chen mchog gi gar rol sa gsum 'gran bral grub dbang rin po che yi gser khrir skyong ba snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed spang 'phags gdung grol mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags kyis bka' gsungs spyi bor phebs pa dang*/ ma zad rigs mthun grogs po gnyis nas yang yang du bskul ba la brten/ rgod rje'i rigs rus thob pa/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des/ bon gyi 'dus sde dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du dkar chag yi ger btab ste phul ba'o//
